pro_course_detail.title: Interview Preparation and Role Play (STAR method)
pro_course_detail.description:
How you perform in your 60-90 minute interview will determine what you do for a living, which in turn will shape much of your life including what you do all day and what you can afford to enjoy in life.

In your classes, I will prepare you to answer the most common interview questions as well as the questions most likely to be asked in your own interview. 

I will explain exactly what information you are being asked for, why, and how you should structure your answers. 

We will prepare you for your interview by practising the questions through role play so that you will speak confidently at your interview. 

Here are some of the questions you will be answering confidently by the end of your classes:

1. Can you tell me a little about yourself?
2. How did you hear about the position?
3. What do you know about the company?
4. Why should we hire you?
5. What are your greatest professional strengths?
6. What do you consider to be your weaknesses?
7. What is your greatest professional achievement?
8. Tell me about a challenge or conflict you've faced at work, and how you dealt with it.
9. Where do you see yourself in 5 years?
10. Why are you leaving your current job?
11. What other companies are you interviewing with?
12. How would your co-workers describe you?
13. Describe your first 30 days in this role

Ready to take the next step in your career? Then let's begin

Complete beginners will start with pronunciation and simple greetings and phrases, and progress from there. You will gain a knowledge of how the language works, as well as how to form sentences of your own. You will also learn about Scottish Gaelic culture.

レッスン情報：スコットランドゲール語 －３０分間～６０分間、初級から ～上級まで

On parle le gaélique (Gàidhlig par son propre nom) en Écosse, avec sa langue standard distincte du gaélique irlandais (Gaeilge), depuis le troisième siècle et c’était la langue parlée par la majorité des écossais jusqu’à un certain temps entre les 15ème et 17ème siècles. 

Si on connait le gaélique, on détient la clé de mieux connaitre l’Écosse – son histoire, son patrimoine et sa culture – et il vous offre des perspectives uniques sur la vie moderne aussi. 

Bien que le gaélique soit une langue minoritaire en Écosse tout entière, toutefois il est parlé toujours par une majorité de la population des Hébrides Extérieures (Eilean Siar), et une connaissance de base serait utile et avantageux pour tous ceux qui veulent voyager, vivre ou travailler dans les Hébrides Extérieurs ou Intérieurs (les Îles de l’ouest) ou même dans les Highlands (Hautes-terres) d’Écosse. 

スコットランドゲール語は、ハイランド地方やアウター・ヘブリディーズ（西岸に連なる鎖状の島々）に行く機会がある場合、役に立つことがあります。特に、アウター・ヘブリディーズでは、人口の６０％の人々に、母語として話されています。
